The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To understand the concept of search engines using the provided analogy: Imagine you are looking for a specific recipe in a massive library. The library contains millions of books (websites), and each book has thousands of pages (web pages). Without a system to organize these books, finding the right recipe would be like searching for a needle in a haystack. A library index (the search engine) catalogs every book and page, allowing you to type in keywords like "chocolate cake" and instantly locate the exact book and page that contains that information. Similarly, search engines like Google index the vast content of the internet, enabling users to quickly find the specific websites and pages that match their queries.
